Phase-2.NAME: MyGraceCore
Phase-2.purpose: Integrate MyGRACE docs, CLI-equivalent operations, and canonical skills into the Reasonix runtime.

steps.step-1: Port index parsing, per-entity lookup, lint, and file markup inspection into Node-compatible TypeScript.
steps.step-2: Register the 14 canonical MyGRACE skill bodies and metadata.
steps.step-3: Create `/mygrace:*` command resolver independent of Reasonix skill filename limits.
steps.step-4: Add deterministic tests for init, status, ask, lint, module show, phase show, and file show flows.
steps.step-5: Run MyGRACE lint against MAGRA after every generated docs change.

evidence.command-1: rtk npm test -- tests/mygrace-docs.test.ts tests/mygrace-cli-adapter.test.ts tests/mygrace-skills.test.ts
evidence.note-1: MyGRACE skill bodies are bundled as lazy runtime assets under src/mygrace/skill-bodies and copied to dist during build.
